_readme: Bibliography backing js/citations.js. Keys are referenced from model/registry.json's dataset.citationKey field, js/citations.js's ENGINE_CITATIONS/CORE_CITATIONS/OTHER_METHOD_CITATIONS maps, or both. `type` drives BibTeX/RIS entry type (see js/citations.js's BIBTEX_TYPE/RIS_TYPE maps): 'article-journal' | 'thesis' | 'software' | 'dataset' | 'paper-conference' | 'preprint'. An entry with no `doi` has one deliberately left out rather than guessed -- see its own `note` field for why. Every doi/volume/pages value below was verified against a publisher page, PubMed, or another independent source via live web search on 2026-08-24 (see each entry's `note` for corroborating sources); do not add a new value here without the same kind of verification.

entries.title: Graph neural networks for identifying protein reactive electrophiles
entries.note: Source of the electrophile-reactivity-v1 training data (RowleyGroup/covalent-classifier) -- verified directly from model/electrophile-reactivity/README.md

entries.title: pKalculator: A pKa predictor for C-H bonds
entries.note: ChemRxiv preprint, not yet confirmed as journal-published; author list beyond Ree not yet verified. Source of both the pka-ch-nagl model's method and its training data (jensengroup/pKalculator) -- verified directly from PKA_INTEGRATION.md

entries.title: Exact Analytical Algorithm for the Solvent-Accessible Surface Area and Derivatives in Implicit Solvent Molecular Simulations on GPUs
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
entries.note: Confirmed directly from the local PDF (ct3c01366.pdf) header. Basis for js/dsasa.js's analytical SASA/gradient construction

entries.title: Delaunay-Laguerre Geometry For Macromolecular Modeling And Implicit Solvation
entries.note: PhD dissertation; UNM Digital Repository lists no DOI. Publication date on the repository record is 2015 (2015-01-28) -- js/dsasa.js's own comments currently say 2014, worth reconciling. The authoritative derivation source for js/dsasa.js (thesis eqs 4.4.x), cited as ref 33/34 in Cao2024dSASA

entries.title: RDKit: Open-source cheminformatics
entries.note: No single canonical journal paper. This is RDKit's 'concept DOI' (github.com/rdkit/rdkit's Zenodo integration) -- always resolves to the most recent release rather than one fixed version; see rdkit.org/docs/Overview.html#citing-the-rdkit if you need a version-pinned DOI instead. Verified via Zenodo search (zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.591637) and github.com/rdkit/rdkit/discussions/5024

entries.title: NMRexp
entries.note: Author list not yet verified -- DOI itself confirmed (already used elsewhere in this app, see model/registry.json's nmr-19f dataset.sourceUrl and NMR_INTEGRATION.md). Source of most of the 19F NMR shift model's training data (single-F molecules only)

entries.title: OPERA models for predicting physicochemical properties and environmental fate endpoints
entries.note: Verified via jcheminf.biomedcentral.com and PubMed (PMID 29520515). Source of the logp-v1 training data (OPERA LogP_2.9_update.csv)

entries.title: In Silico Prediction of Physicochemical Properties of Environmental Chemicals Using Molecular Fingerprints and Machine Learning
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
entries.note: Verified via PubMed (PMID 28006899) and the ACS Publications page (pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jcim.6b00625). This is the OPERA vapor-pressure endpoint's source paper -- vapor-pressure-v1 trains on a derived CSV (gkxiao/vapor-pressure), not this paper's own data files directly

entries.title: Machine learning meets pKa
entries.note: Verified via f1000research.com and PMC (PMC7096188). Source of the aqueous-pka training data (DataWarrior + ChEMBL25 combined set, via czodrowskilab/Machine-learning-meets-pKa)

entries.title: AqSolDB, a curated reference set of aqueous solubility and 2D descriptors for a diverse set of compounds
entries.note: Verified via nature.com and PubMed (PMID 31395888). Source of the logs-aqsoldb training data

entries.title: Comprehensive characterization of cytochrome P450 isozyme selectivity across chemical libraries
entries.note: Verified via nature.com and PMC (PMC2783980). Source of PubChem BioAssay AID 1851, the training data for the cyp{1a2,2c9,2c19,2d6,3a4}-inhibition-v1 models

entries.title: Expansion of bond dissociation prediction with machine learning to medicinally and environmentally relevant chemical space
entries.note: Verified via pubs.rsc.org and OSTI.GOV (osti.gov/pages/biblio/2203761). Source of BDE-db2 (patonlab/BDE-db2), the bde-chemprop-v1 training data

entries.title: Quantum chemistry structures and properties of 134 kilo molecules
entries.note: Verified via nature.com. Source of the QM9 dataset (qm9-polarizability, qm9-homo-lumo-gap training data)

entries.title: Jean-Claude Bradley Double Plus Good (Highly Curated and Validated) Melting Point Dataset
entries.note: Verified via figshare.com and Semantic Scholar. Source of the melting-point model's training data; DOI already used elsewhere in this app (model/registry.json's dataset.sourceUrl)

entries.title: Curated CYP450 Interaction Dataset: Covering the Majority of Phase I Drug Metabolism
entries.note: IMPORTANT NAMING MISMATCH: the registry citationKey 'Xu2025' implies a first author 'Xu', but this paper's actual first author is Ni -- confirmed via nature.com and matched by its identical figshare DOI (10.6084/m9.figshare.26630515, same as model/registry.json's dataset.sourceUrl for the cyp*-substrate-v1 models). Consider renaming the registry key to something like 'Ni2025CYP450' for accuracy; kept as 'Xu2025' here only to match the registry as-is. Full author list beyond the first three not yet verified

entries.title: Chemprop: A Machine Learning Package for Chemical Property Prediction
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
entries.note: Verified via ACS Publications and PubMed (PMID 38147829). The Chemprop v2 package every chemprop-engine model in this app (registry.json's 'engine': 'chemprop') is built on

entries.title: Analyzing Learned Molecular Representations for Property Prediction
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
entries.note: Verified via ACS Publications and PubMed (PMID 31361484). The original D-MPNN (bond-centered message passing) architecture js/dmpnn.js reimplements

entries.title: Transfer learning for solvation free energies: From quantum chemistry to experiments
entries.note: Verified via the ADS abstract service and ScienceDirect; article number 129307 matches the DOI suffix already used elsewhere in this app (model/registry.json's solv-*-v1 dataset.sourceUrl fields). Source of CombiSolv-QM, the training data for all 21 per-solvent solvation free energy models

entries.title: qHTS assay for small molecule inhibitors of the human ether-a-go-go related gene (hERG) channel, confirmatory
entries.note: PubChem BioAssay AID 588834 -- a deposited screening dataset, not a journal paper, so no DOI exists to cite; title taken directly from the AID's own PubChem record. Source of the herg-inhibition-v1 training data

entries.title: A Graph Neural Network Charge Model Targeting Accurate Electrostatic Properties of Organic Molecules
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
entries.note: IMPERFECT MATCH, flagged honestly: this describes OpenFF's NAGL charge-model infrastructure generally (2025); it may postdate or differ from the specific checkpoint (nagl-v1-mbis-dipole.ckpt, from github.com/jthorton/nagl-mbis) this app's nagl-model.js actually converted and loads. No paper describing that exact MBIS checkpoint was confidently found -- verify against jthorton/nagl-mbis's own README/paper reference before citing this formally

entries.title: Extending the Applicability of the ANI Deep Learning Molecular Potential to Sulfur and Halogens
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
entries.note: Verified via ACS Publications and PubMed (PMID 32543858); full author list beyond Devereux not yet verified (paper is known to include Smith, Barros, Zubatyuk, Isayev, Roitberg among others -- confirm before formal citation). The ANI-2x potential ani2x-model.js runs (via the torchani-trained weights)

entries.title: GeoMol: Torsional Geometric Generation of Molecular 3D Conformer Ensembles
entries.booktitle: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34 (NeurIPS 2021)
entries.note: Verified via papers.nips.cc/proceedings.neurips.cc and arXiv (2106.07802). No DOI -- NeurIPS proceedings papers don't carry one; arXiv id given instead. The architecture js/geomol-model.js/geomol-assembly.js reimplement for the GeoMol 3D-generation option

entries.title: Automated exploration of the low-energy chemical space with fast quantum chemical methods
entries.note: Verified via pubs.rsc.org and ADS. The real CREST/CREGEN algorithm js/conformer-search.js's conformer search is inspired by (see CONFORMER_SEARCH.md for what's a literal port vs. reimplemented)

entries.title: New Substructure Filters for Removal of Pan Assay Interference Compounds (PAINS) from Screening Libraries and for Their Exclusion in Bioassays
entries.note: Verified via ACS Publications. The original PAINS filter set among the ~1250 SMARTS filters in data/smarts_filters.json (via github.com/PatWalters/rd_filters, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

entries.title: Development and Benchmarking of Open Force Field 2.0.0: The Sage Small Molecule Force Field
entries.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
entries.note: Verified via ACS Publications and PubMed (PMID 37167319); full author list beyond Boothroyd not yet verified (known to include Behara, Madin, and others -- confirm before formal citation). The Sage 2.1.0 force field js/openff-forcefield.js applies

entries.title: 3Dmol.js: molecular visualization with WebGL
entries.note: Verified via academic.oup.com. The library js/viewer3d.js wraps for the 3D view tab

entries.title: Quantifying the chemical beauty of drugs
entries.note: Verified via nature.com. js/qed.js is a from-scratch, bit-exact port of RDKit's own QED implementation of this paper's method

entries.title: Estimation of synthetic accessibility score of drug-like molecules based on molecular complexity and fragment contributions
entries.note: Verified via jcheminf.biomedcentral.com. js/sascorer.js is a from-scratch, bit-exact port of RDKit's own Contrib/SA_Score implementation of this paper's method -- see CHEMPROP_INTEGRATION.md

entries.title: MarkushGlyph and OCSRGlyph: Improved Chemical Structure Recognition
entries.note: Verified via arxiv.org (2607.28532). The published paper behind OCSRGlyph, the model js/ocsrglyph-model.js runs for the Image → Structure tab (github.com/EdisonScientific/glyph)

entries.title: NMRShiftDB - compound identification and structure elucidation support through a free community-built web database
entries.note: IMPERFECT MATCH, flagged honestly: this is the original NMRShiftDB paper (2004); no single canonical paper specifically for its 'nmrshiftdb2' successor (the version this app's nmr-{13c,1h,19f} models actually source data from, per NMR_INTEGRATION.md) was confidently identified -- the closest candidate found was a 2012 J. Cheminform. conference-supplement poster abstract (DOI 10.1186/1758-2946-4-S1-P52), not a full paper. Verify before citing formally
